category_title: High-ability students who resist training and rely on rereading for memorization
scenario_title: Resisting new study strategies and expressing low self-esteem during SRL training
minimal_context: The student is examining the learning objectives for her modular math course and writing down which resources she will use to study.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: For this task, please examine the learning objectives for our math module and describe in writing which resources you will use to study.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I looked at the modules, but I'm not going to study differently. I already use many of the tactics presented in the training.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please write down the specific strategies you plan to use for these objectives.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'm just going to read the textbook chapters again. Like I wrote down, rereading and spacing can help me better memorize the material.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What do you think about trying some of the other new strategies we discussed instead of just rereading?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'm not changing how I study. It's not going to make a difference anyway because everyone knows I am just dumb.

task.content: Examine the tasks posed and resources provided in their course and to describe in writing the resources that are appropriate for each learning objective
task.learning_goal: Enhance students' ability to self-regulate learning

context.environment: Developmental mathematics context with collaborative learning activities
context.materials: Adaptive learning technologies (ALEKS), online LMS, instructor provided resources, journaling materials, model answers
context.social_setting: Modular math course, second attempt, collaborative learning situations
context.time_context: First week of a revisited modular math course

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: After viewing the modules and being prompted to apply the learning principle in their own course
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Indicated that they would not study differently, selected additional ones – such as rereading – which are known to be less effective, and keeps saying everyone knows she is 'dumb'
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: High anxiety and fear of failure, very low self-esteem, believed that they already used many of the tactics presented
related_quotes: rereading and spacing can help me better memorize the material

behavior_patterns.condition: When facing assessments or evaluating her own ability
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Keeps saying everyone knows she is 'dumb'
behavior_patterns.internal_state: Very low self-esteem, high anxiety and fear of failure

behavior_patterns.condition: When presented with new study strategies in training
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Indicated that they would not study differently, selected additional ones – such as rereading
behavior_patterns.internal_state: Believed that they already used many of the tactics presented in the intervention, deriving from history of past success
